config:
[target.wasm32-unknown-unknown]
rustflags = [
  "-C", "link-arg=--max-memory=4294967296",
  "-C", "link-arg=-zstack-size=8388608",
  "-C", "target-feature=+simd128",
]

# `[unstable] build-std` intentionally lives OUTSIDE this file, not here.
# `[unstable]` is a whole-invocation table, not scoped to `[target.*]` — if it
# were set here it would apply to every `cargo` invocation in this workspace,
# including plain host builds (`cargo test --release`, `cargo build`, etc.),
# which have no `--target` and therefore no reason to rebuild `std` from
# source. That collided with `[profile.release] panic = "abort"` in the
# workspace `Cargo.toml` and made `cargo test --release` fail everywhere with
# "duplicate lang item in crate `core`" — nothing to do with the code under
# test.
#
# The wasm build needs `build-std` (it links a custom `panic_abort`-only
# `std` for the single-thread bundle, and an atomics-enabled `std` for the
# threaded bundle — see `scripts/build-wasm.sh`). It gets it by setting the
# `CARGO_UNSTABLE_BUILD_STD` env var for that invocation only, so only the
# wasm build pays for it. See `scripts/build-wasm.sh`.
